motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Label color change in the filter switch and the account chevron rotation.

motion.name: sidebar-reveal
motion.purpose: Account folder expansion: size plus fade, top-center aligned; no motion when reduced motion is on.

motion.name: selection-spring
motion.value: spring, 420ms duration, bounce 0.12, retargets from current velocity
motion.purpose: The single selection pill. Interruptible mid-flight; resolves instantly when the OS reports reduced motion.

motion.name: page-liquid-reveal
motion.value: 420ms enter / 280ms exit; easeInOutCubic; 16 smooth cubic segments
motion.purpose: Opaque surface spreads from the recent click to cover the whole page; text stays stationary. One reversible progress function, no separate controller or idle timer. Center fallback and immediate full surface under reduced motion.

motion.name: native-interactive-back
motion.value: Cupertino/PredictiveBack builders stay mounted; ordinary primary1/secondary0, actual animation during pop gesture
motion.purpose: Retain platform gesture recognition, cancellation and PopScope guards. Expansion clip is disabled for native interactive back; it stays in the same widget ancestry.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Day-theme filled primary action; night uses current primary/onPrimary roles. Brand-blue FAB and filter stay fixed.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #002FA7; color: #FFFFFF; font: 700 14px/1.43 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 999px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 999px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0, 47, 167, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.38; cursor: default; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action used for reply, reply-all and forward. Hairline border on transparent ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #E3E4DF; border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; color: #002FA7; font: 600 14px/1.43 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 999px rgba(0, 47, 167, 0.06); } .ds-btn-outlined:active { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 999px rgba(0, 47, 167, 0.1); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0, 47, 167, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Filled field with a 1dp hairline that turns Klein blue at 1.6dp on focus. Text is 16sp; no outer glow.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 400 12px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #5A6478; } .ds-field-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #E3E4DF; border-radius: 14px; background: #F4F5F1; color: #17213B; font: 400 16px/1.45 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #5A6478; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: #C7CBD2; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #002FA7; border-width: 1.6px; } .ds-field-input:disabled { opacity: 0.38; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: 48dp rounded list row. The selected account or unified inbox gets the soft blue fill and deep blue text, never a side bar.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="邮箱"><button class="ds-nav-item ds-nav-item-selected" type="button" aria-current="page">聚合收件箱</button><button class="ds-nav-item" type="button">账户管理</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 260px; padding: 8px; background: #F7F7F2; border-radius: 14px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; color: #17213B; font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 999px rgba(0, 47, 167, 0.05); } .ds-nav-item-selected { background: #E4EBFF; color: #00164D; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0, 47, 167, 0.35); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Filter Switch
components.description: Signature all/unread control: a 56dp stadium track holding one Klein-blue pill. Only the pill moves; labels never resize. The browser analog uses a short ease, the app uses a 420ms spring at bounce 0.12 with instant reduced-motion placement.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: #E9ECF3; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-filter-seg { min-width: 84px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #5A6478; font: 600 14px/1.43 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-filter-seg:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 999px rgba(0, 47, 167, 0.05); } .ds-filter-seg-on { background: #002FA7; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; } .ds-filter-seg:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0, 47, 167, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-filter-seg { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview: 本地邮箱的视觉系统是一条稳定电流：导航与选择由克莱因蓝承担，阅读表面保持不透明的安静，交互时，页面从触点扩散，筛选胶囊连续移动；静止时不运行装饰动画。页面不靠装饰、模糊或透明度表达“流动”，而靠颜色占比、连续曲率和一个可以被中途改意的弹性位移，让操作读起来像一股不间断的水流。系统的密度是中等偏舒适的：邮件行至少 110dp 高，行距足以扫读发件人、主题与时间；导航、控件与容器共享同一套圆角家族，避免相邻表面出现互不相干的曲率。层次靠实心表面之间的明度差与 1dp 发丝线建立，卡片与列表默认平铺；模态面板沿用 Material 原生抬升，系统没有自定义或装饰性阴影。这套世界同时服务手机与电脑：手机主界面是蓝色头部加一张上圆角的白色阅读面板，其他阅读与设置页面仍使用当前主题的表面色顶栏；电脑是同一语言下的两栏或三栏。栏数改变，配色、字体层级、圆角与控制手感不变。
keyCharacteristics: 克莱因蓝只做导航、选择与主操作；大面积留给象牙白/纸白或深夜蓝。
所有承托表面不透明；流动感来自运动与曲率，不来自模糊或半透明。
层级靠字重、字距、明度差与发丝线，不靠多字体家族。
控件圆角来自同一家族（14/18/22/24/28），胶囊是唯一的全圆角。
触点扩散负责页面导航，弹性胶囊负责筛选；两者响应减少动画，静止时不运行。

rules.name: The Klein Constant Rule
rules.body: 克莱因蓝是导航与选择的常量。夜间模式替换表面、文字和小面积强调，不替换这块蓝；任何新界面都不得引入第二个“主色”与它竞争。手机主界面的蓝色头部是允许的大面积用色——占比服从页面角色，而不是一条全局的“少用蓝”配额。

rules.name: The Opaque Bearing Rule
rules.body: 承托邮件的表面必须不透明。不要用毛玻璃、背景模糊、半透明蒙层来表现流动或层级；Material 标准的状态层与过渡透明度不受此限。

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: 只用系统文本字体家族。层级由字重、字号、字距与颜色完成，不新增展示字体或额外字体依赖；图标沿用框架自带的 MaterialIcons，需要“更强调”时先加字重或提高对比，而不是换字体。

rules.name: The Still Label Rule
rules.body: 选择态切换时，标签文字的位置、字号与行高不变，只换颜色。运动属于胶囊，不属于文字。

rules.name: The Native-Lift Rule
rules.body: 静止的卡片、AppBar、列表与侧栏保持 elevation 0，需要分层时先换表面色或加发丝线。对话框、菜单、抽屉、底部面板与 Snackbar 沿用 Material 原生 elevation；不要为它们手写阴影，也不要把写信按钮的 elevation 复制到普通表面。

rules.name: The One Curvature Rule
rules.body: 同一屏内的容器只从 14/18/22/24/28 中取用，并保持“越小越方、越大越圆”的顺序。不要为单个组件发明 8dp 或 12dp 的孤立圆角；胶囊只属于选择控件。

dos: Do 用 `colors.klein-blue` 承担导航、选择、未读标记和主操作；其余表面保持纸白/象牙白或深夜蓝。
Do 让手机阅读面板保持 28dp 上圆角与实心底色，用弧线切开蓝色头部，不用投影或半透明过渡。
Do 用字重、字距、字色与发丝线建立层级；标题收紧字距（−0.2 至 −0.8），正文保持 1.4–1.45 行高。
Do 让时间列使用等宽数字，并让右列随系统字号增宽，保证大字体下最后一位不被裁切。
Do 所有可点目标保持至少 48dp 的响应区域；图标按钮保留 tooltip，并保留原生焦点、键盘与系统返回手势。
Do 选择态只移动胶囊，文字位置与字号保持不变；开启减少动画时即时落位。
Do 需要分层时先换不透明表面色或加 1dp 发丝线；只有模态与悬浮动作使用原生抬升。
donts: Don't 使用毛玻璃、背景模糊、半透明面板或渐变来表现“流动”；流动由运动、曲率和蓝色占比表达。
Don't 捆绑或声明自有的展示字体，也不要新增图标字体依赖；文本走系统字体，图标使用框架自带的 MaterialIcons。
Don't 为卡片、列表与侧栏手写投影，也不要把写信按钮的 elevation 复制到普通表面；对话框、菜单、抽屉、底部面板与 Snackbar 的原生抬升不在此限。
Don't 引入第二品牌色；success/warning/danger 只用于状态，星标与连接状态也不得扩散成大色块。
Don't 为单个组件发明家族外的圆角，或把胶囊圆角用于普通容器。
Don't 在选择动画中缩放、位移或改写标签文字，也不要在静止界面保留装饰性循环动画。
Don't 把普通页面跳转改回横向翻页，也不要复制平台私有手势控制器；保留系统返回手势、取消行为和草稿保护。
